hero.title: Mint Masala: Where Culinary Traditions Ignite in a Modern Setting.
hero.subtitle: Savor the fiery embrace of Indian spices, the subtle elegance of Chinese herbs, and a touch of Continental flair. Your chic dining adventure at Mint Masala begins here.

about.title: The Mint Masala Experience
about.paragraph1: At Mint Masala, we've crafted a chic, trendy culinary destination, artfully combining the most popular and sought-after Indian, Tandoor, and Chinese offerings, beautifully complemented by a delightful sprinkling of Continental delights. We are more than just a restaurant; we are a vibrant fusion.
about.paragraph2: Here at Mint Masala, the fiery confluence of Indian spices shares your table with the gentle nudges of Chinese herbs and seasonings. Step into our elegant space, designed for modern diners seeking an unforgettable multi-cuisine journey that’s both bold and exquisitely refined.
